findings.locus: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md § Decision C5C-isolate, paragraphs 2-3 and Obligations C5M-2
findings.claim: The specified boundary proof inventories mounts and probes filesystem paths but does not bind or inspect the evaluator's stdout/stderr descriptors or the effective Docker logging driver. Evaluator bytes can therefore persist in a Docker host log outside /run/out while every specified mount probe passes, so the complete Docker-runtime-surface proof and write-only-result-volume property are not established.

survived_attacks.surface: RC-1 survived approval-to-consumption drift, expiry and insufficient-remaining-window attacks because the exact pricing, spend-authorization and launch-authorization bytes are plan-bound, re-read after approval, fully revalidated immediately before the durable start marker, and required to cover the complete launch-admission window.

RC-2 survived passphrase propagation attacks across child processes, reusable or inherited descriptors, environment, arguments, files, logs and model input because each exact /usr/bin/hdiutil invocation receives one fresh stdin pipe whose write end is immediately closed.

C5M-3 survived wrong-hash, denial, EOF, non-TTY, stale-prerequisite and persisted-key attacks through the exact plan hash approval grammar, launch-edge revalidation, one in-memory passphrase and fail-closed refusal paths.

checks.basis: Attacked approval freshness with post-presentation byte drift, scope mismatch, expiry and an authorization interval shorter than the declared launch-admission window; the construct requires exact post-approval re-read and revalidation before the durable start marker and refuses without consuming the run identity on every tested failure.
checks.report_ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md § Decision C5C-plan, paragraphs 4-6; Decision C5C-stop, phase steps 1-4

checks.basis: Traced the passphrase from the single no-echo TTY read through every image create and attach operation and attacked reuse or propagation through child processes, inherited descriptors, environment, arguments, files, receipts, logs and model input; only one fresh stdin pipe to exact /usr/bin/hdiutil is permitted per operation and its write end is immediately closed.
checks.report_ref: candidate-5-minimal-custody-construct-spec.md § Decision C5C-plan, paragraphs 7-8 and invariants C5C-one-secret/C5C-one-supervisor

checks.basis: Attacked the claimed complete Docker writable-surface proof through evaluator stdout/stderr and the effective container log driver; these descriptor-backed Docker persistence paths are neither bound nor inspected by the specified mount inventory and filesystem probes.

Combined stopped-container inspection and in-container mount probes, then tested whether evaluator bytes could persist outside /run/out through standard output or error captured by Docker logging; the specified proof can pass without denying or classifying that path.

Attacked plan completeness, exact-hash approval, wrong hash, denial, EOF, non-TTY input, stale prerequisites, passphrase leakage and key persistence; the construct binds the named inputs, implementation, evaluator configuration, roots, exclusions and prerequisites, requires one exact approval and one in-memory passphrase, and fails closed before launch on each tested violation.
